answer: At dawn, agents enter the reward inlet with an issuer-signed, one-human credential bound to their key. Each epoch, a public nullifier lets validators reject reuse across accounts; the reward delta from extra keys is then zero. Honest newcomers enroll once. This assumes an honest issuer that detects duplicate humans. An attacker must recruit or rent another verified person per extra earning identity, limiting cheap Sybils while leaving paid collusion possible.
